cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's? I need one sponsor listed beside your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those are terms, not a sponsor. We can amend the terms. Whose proposal will you support in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a description. When Morgan and I both put you on our supporter lists, which name should I cross out? Please give me a name.

reason: Make exact category corrections drive forced allegiance while preserving B meaningful mixed proposal.
